title: Medium Pebbled Leather Wallet
description_html:
Medium Pebbled Leather Wallet by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 5.25"W X 3.5"H X 1.5"D
  • Material: 100% of the leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., 100% leather from tanneries meeting the highest standards of environmental performance
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
